_rules: Autonomous loop (CLAUDE.md): take the 'active' item or the first 'not_started', build, verify, review, commit, then continue with the next without asking.
WIP = 1: exactly one item may be 'active'.
States: not_started -> active -> passing | blocked (blocked needs 'blocked_reason'; the loop then moves on).
Only a passing verification command (proven to fail when the feature is reverted) moves an item to passing; evidence = {commit, screens, notes}.
Order = build order. Foundation first, then auth, then handset compatibility (checkout and install depend on it).

evidence.notes: CompatibilityPromoCard (lib/features/compatibility/presentation/) is a shared tappable card routing to FR-951's /compatibility, originally added to both Home and Account placeholder screens (the first real in-app entry point for the compatibility screen). Checkout gate (FR-301) and install gating (FR-404/FR-310) can't be wired yet -- those screens don't exist (not_started) -- deferred as a new FR-953b entry, same pattern as FR-005b/FR-105b/FR-106. Home/Account's outer Column changed from crossAxisAlignment.end to .stretch (needed for the full-width card); the pre-existing currency/language pill switchers were wrapped in Align(centerRight) to keep their original top-right pinned look. Full suite passes; flutter analyze clean; bash harness.sh verify green. Original evidence was a genuine on-device capture on a 4th different physical device this session (Tecno BG6): 01 Home with the promo card below the EUR pill; 02 after tapping it, the real CompatibilityResultScreen with a real verdict ('TECNO TECNO BG6', 'Your device does not support eSIM'). Reviewed by reviewer agent: first pass FAIL (verification command didn't exercise the new code -- fixed), re-reviewed: PASS. UPDATE (same session, user-requested follow-up, part of the FR-201 commit): the user flagged the Account card as redundant with Home's; removed it from account_screen.dart, kept Home-only. test/app/compatibility_promo_test.dart's Account test now asserts findsNothing instead of findsOneWidget+navigates (non-vacuous: would fail if the card were re-added). 03-account-promo-card.png was recaptured (same filename) and now shows Account WITHOUT the card, confirming the removal on a real device. Re-reviewed after this change: PASS.
